title: Email Newsletter Design for the launch of Bali Body's Shimmering Tanning Oil SPF15
description:
Designed this fun, retro-inspired EDM for Bali Body’s Watermelon SPF50 Sunscreen Oil launch! Pulled in all the best 60s/70s beach vibes. Think bold fonts, warm sunset hues, and a laid-back surf feel. Wanted it to feel effortlessly cool, just like those sun-soaked summer days.

If you’re looking for eye-catching EDMs or need a graphic designer for your digital marketing, let’s chat!
